summary: The prototype catalog builds from `scripts/build-prototype-catalog.mjs` on every push to main; dates come from `git log`, versions from the nearest release tag, and a prototype with no git provenance is marked rather than guessed.
reader_impact: The catalog's 252 rows carry real provenance — 77 git dates and 54 release tags, with 175 untracked rows flagged amber — and every deep link still resolves on the public, `noindex` site.
